q3_largest_fragment_dim.note: L=18 (paper's printed Table III value 6626, root state 001000100010111111) is DELIBERATELY OMITTED from this list. Independent recomputation directly from the paper's own Hamiltonian (Eq. 1-2) and its own explicit range-3 transition list (Eq. 4, .figures/arxiv__2503.09452/2503.09452.pdf-0005-13.png) -- validated symbol-by-symbol against Eq. 4 and cross-checked with three independently-coded brute-force enumerations (tuple/BFS global partition, per-N_f-sector exhaustive enumeration, bitmask/DFS) -- gives 6266 for that root state's fragment dimension at L=18, not 6626. All other 14 points in this row and all 85 other datapoints across the sibling targets (tables I,II,IV-VIII) matched the paper exactly, and the L=6..20 sequence is smooth/monotonic under 6266 but has a sharp outlier under 6626, so this looks like a digit-transposition typo in the published table rather than a bug in this recomputation. Value not silently corrected in-place (that would override a human-ratified schema.toml entry without sign-off); the datapoint is dropped instead and schema.toml truth.table_III should be reviewed upstream.
